Super Rare.name: Advanced Ritual Art
Super Rare.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the GY whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

Super Rare.name: Bujingi Turtle
Super Rare.desc: During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Bujin" monster you control (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate that effect.

Super Rare.name: Card Trooper
Super Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the GY; this card gains 500 ATK for each card sent to the GY this way, until the end of this turn. If this card you control is destroyed and sent to your GY: Draw 1 card.

Super Rare.name: Charge of the Light Brigade
Super Rare.desc: Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard; add 1 Level 4 or lower "Lightsworn" monster from your Deck to your hand.

Super Rare.name: Full House
Super Rare.desc: Target 2 other face-up Spell/Trap Cards and 3 Set Spell/Trap Cards, on the field; destroy them.

Super Rare.name: Geargiarsenal
Super Rare.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each "Geargia" monster you control. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Geargia" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Geargiarsenal".

Super Rare.name: Jenis, Lightsworn Mender
Super Rare.desc: During the End Phase, if a card(s) was sent from your Deck to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Lightsworn" card this turn: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, gain 500 LP.

Super Rare.name: Mermail Abysspike
Super Rare.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard; add 1 Level 3 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abysspike" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Overworked
Super Rare.desc: Destroy each monster whose ATK is higher than its original ATK.

Super Rare.name: Star Drawing
Super Rare.desc:
If this card is used for an Xyz Summon, you can treat it as a Level 5 monster. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card as an Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: Draw 1 card.

Short Print.name: Blackland Fire Dragon
Short Print.desc: A dragon that dwells in the depths of darkness, its vulnerability lies in its poor eyesight.

Common.name: Book of Moon
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: Copy Plant
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 other Plant-Type monster on the field that has a Level; this card's Level becomes that monster's current Level, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Empress of Prophecy
Common.desc:
2 Level 5 Spellcaster-Type monsters
This card gains 300 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to a monster you control. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; shuffle your Deck, then excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, destroy monsters on the field up to the number of "Spellbook" cards excavated, also, after that, place the excavated cards on the top of the Deck in any order.

Common.name: Hanewata
Common.desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no effect damage this turn.

Common.name: Jurrac Impact
Common.desc: If you control a Dinosaur-Type monster with 2500 or more ATK: Destroy all cards on the field.

Common.name: Lightsworn Sabre
Common.desc: Equip only to a "Lightsworn" monster. It gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from your Deck to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Lightsworn" monster you control; equip this card to that target.

Common.name: Queen of Thorns
Common.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Plant-Type monsters
Each player must pay 1000 LP for each monster Normal or Special Summoned from their hand, except for Plant-Type monsters.

Common.name: Rinyan, Lightsworn Rogue
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 "Lightsworn" monster in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into your Deck, then draw 1 card.

Common.name: Soul Exchange
Common.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Spellbook Library of the Heliosphere
Common.desc: If you have 5 or more "Spellbook" Spell Cards in your Graveyard: Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, add any excavated "Spellbook" Spell Cards to your hand, also shuffle the other cards into the Deck. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook Library of the Heliosphere" per turn. You cannot activate any Spell Cards the turn you activate this card, except "Spellbook" Spell Cards.

Common.name: Spiritual Forest
Common.desc: Each turn, the first face-up Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Plant-Type monster you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

Ultimate Rare.name: Bujin Yamato
Ultimate Rare.desc: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can add 1 "Bujin" monster from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. You can only control 1 "Bujin Yamato".

Ultimate Rare.name: Gagaga Cowboy
Ultimate Rare.desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; apply this effect, depending on this card's current battle position.
● Attack Position: If this card attacks an opponent's monster this turn, it gains 1000 ATK, also the opponent's monster loses 500 ATK, during the Damage Step only.
● Defense Position: Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

Ultimate Rare.name: Pot of Duality
Ultimate Rare.desc: Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Pot of Duality" per turn. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.
